machine: Apple M5 Max arm64 macOS; Zig 0.15.2; ReleaseFast
base_commit: af6a77f82 plus uncommitted v2/v3 working-tree changes
witness: same 80-byte mainnet genesis header in both profiles
public_output_abi: eight M31 words of the Poseidon2 root; SHA digest is not a public output
privacy_limit: The digest and header are absent from the public statement. This does not establish zero-knowledge confidentiality: the current trace openings are unmasked.
admission_limit: A verifier must derive the Key from trusted, independently compiled source and circuit topology. Key.validate checks internal consistency and cannot authenticate arbitrary prover-supplied source or topology.
proof_system: one native-verifiable PCS/FRI proof per header, 24 components, circuit Gate and ten SHA word claims close in the same transcript

v3.name: two-word shift-register SHA round AIR
native_mutation_checks: changed header paired with original circuit witness
truncated or altered isolated round proof
history, middle, final, carry, K, W, address, selector and padding trace edits

comparison.scope: Matched v2 versus v3 proof topology, source, assignment, private-digest ABI, optimizer and FRI parameters. The earlier generic-circuit baseline was measured by a different harness and is not part of this matched comparison.
comparison.pow_note: The two grinds are deterministic for a given transcript but have chance-dependent duration. Distinct v2/v3 transcript tags produced very different nonce search times, so wall proving time including PoW is not used as evidence of intrinsic chip speed.
comparison.next_bottleneck: The v3 FRI substage median puts composition evaluation and FRI quotient build/commit at about 30 ms each. Fixed commitment is about 33 ms but includes much larger sparse-circuit columns, so sharing the small SHA fixed tables is lower priority without further attribution. A fused schedule/round AIR should be benchmarked against these costs and the generic circuit.

reproduction: Build v2 and v3 with zig build --build-file src/frontends/s31/build.zig <build_step> -Doptimize=ReleaseFast -j2 --verbose.
Run the emitted test binary directly seven times per profile with the respective production_env set; Zig build's run-step cache can replay old timing output.
For each run subtract interaction_pow_ms and fri_pow_ms from prove_ms; alternate v2 and v3 run order, then take per-profile medians.
